Ricerca Voli

Voli diretti trovati:

  • Da: {{flight.departure}} → A: {{flight.destination}} Partenza: {{ flight.dataOra | date:'short' }}, durata: {{ flight.duration }} min Prezzo: {{flight.price}} €

Voli con scalo trovati:

Scalo a: {{conn.layover}} Primo volo: {{conn.firstLeg.departure}} → {{conn.firstLeg.destination}}, Prezzo: {{conn.firstLeg.price}} €, Durata: {{conn.firstLeg.duration}} min Secondo volo: {{conn.secondLeg.departure}} → {{conn.secondLeg.destination}}, Prezzo: {{conn.secondLeg.price}} €, Durata: {{conn.secondLeg.duration}} min Totale: Prezzo: {{conn.firstLeg.price + conn.secondLeg.price}} €, Durata: {{conn.firstLeg.duration + conn.secondLeg.duration}} min
import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { FlightSearchService, LayoverConnection, FlightInfo } from '../../services/search.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-search', templateUrl: './search.component.html', styleUrls: ['./search.component.css'] }) export class FlightSearchComponent { depart: string = ''; destination: string = ''; loading = false; errorMessage = ''; //results : any[] = []; directFlights: FlightInfo[] = []; layoverConnections: LayoverConnection[] = []; constructor(private flightSearchService: FlightSearchService) {} search(/*depart: string, destination: string*/) { this.errorMessage = ''; this.loading = true; this.directFlights = []; this.layoverConnections = []; this.flightSearchService.searchFlights(this.depart, this.destination).subscribe({ next: (results) => { console.log("Ricerca avvenuta"); this.loading = false; if(results.length === 0){ this.errorMessage = 'Nessun volo trovato'; return; } if ('firstLeg' in results[0]) { // Sono connessioni con scalo this.layoverConnections = results as LayoverConnection[]; } else { // Sono voli diretti this.directFlights = results as FlightInfo[]; } }, error: (err) => { this.loading = false; this.errorMessage = err.error?.errormessage || 'Errore durante la ricerca voli.'; } }); } }
